P.name: Dream-Laden Bough
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Lillia's''' {{tip|abilities}} apply ''Dream Dust'' to enemies hit, which deals{{ft|{{as|5% {{as|(+ {{fd|1.25}}% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}} {{as|'''total''' magic damage}} over 3 seconds, capped at {{pplevel|70 to 180}} against {{tip|monster|monsters}}.|{{as|{{fd|0.8{{Recurring|3}}}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.208{{Recurring|3}}}}% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}} {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds over 3 seconds, capped at {{pplevel|70/6 to 180/6}} per tick against {{tip|monster|monsters}}.}}
P.description2: '''Lillia''' {{tip|heals}} herself for{{ft|{{as|39|heal}} {{as|(+ 15% AP)}} against large {{tip|monsters}} and {{pplevel|6 + ((90-6)/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))|color=heal}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}} against {{tip|champions}}|{{as|{{ap|39/6}}|heal}} {{as|(+ {{ap|15/6}}% AP)}} against large {{tip|monsters}} and {{pplevel|6/6 + ((90/6-6/6)/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))|color=heal}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30/6}}% AP)}} against {{tip|champions}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds}}over the duration of ''Dream Dust'', reduced to 15% effectiveness for each target afflicted beyond the first. She may only heal against 1 monster at a time.

Q.name: Blooming Blows
Q.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Whenever '''Lillia's''' {{tip|abilities}} hit at least one enemy, she generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Prance'' for {{fd|6.5}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 4 times. Stacks expire one by one every {{fd|1.5}} seconds when the duration ends.
Q.description2: {{sbc|Prance:}} For each stack, '''Lillia''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Movement Speed per Stack|{{ap|3 to 7}}% {{as|(+ 3% per 100 AP)}}|Maximum Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|3*4 to 7*4}}% {{as|(+ 12% per 100 AP)}}}}
Q.description3: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lillia''' swings her censer around her, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies. Enemies hit within the outer edge of the area additionally take the same amount as {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}}}.
Q.leveling3: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|35 to 75}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}}|Total Mixed Damage|{{ap|35*2 to 75*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|35*2}}% AP)}}}}
Q.description4: '''''Lillia''' can move during Blooming Blows' cast time.''

W.name: Watch Out! Eep!
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lillia''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} to 150 units in front of the target location over {{rutngt|0.75}}, though not through terrain, and deals {{as|magic damage}} in an area around the target spot. Enemies hit within the epicenter are dealt {{ccs|200% increased damage|magic}}.
W.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 160}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}}|Increased Damage|{{ap|80*3 to 160*3}} {{as|(+ 105% AP)}}}}
W.cast time: {{tt|None|Dash starts immediately before a 0.25 cast time, but actual delay is 0.6 to 0.75 seconds}}

E.name: Swirlseed
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lillia''' lobs a seed at the target location that rolls forward indefinitely. The seed detonates upon hitting an enemy or terrain while on the ground, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies in a cone, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 40% for 3 seconds and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for 2 seconds.

R.name: Lilting Lullaby
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lillia''' casts a magical lullaby over all enemy {{tip|champions}} affected by ''{{ai|Dream-Laden Bough|Lillia|Dream Dust}}'', which {{tt|arrives after {{fd|0.3}} seconds|fixed travel time missile}} and renders them {{tip|drowsy}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 10%. After the duration, they fall {{tip|asleep}} for 2 seconds.
R.description2: The next instance of non-{{tip|persistent damage|persistent}} damage that a {{tip|sleep|sleeping}} target takes from {{tip|champions}}, large {{tip|monsters}} or {{tip|turrets}} consumes the debuff to deal {{as|'''additional''' magic damage|magic damage}}.
R.description3: ''An enemy champion affected by {{ai|Dream-Laden Bough|Lillia|Dream Dust}} is required to cast this ability. '''Lillia''' can move during Lilting Lullaby's cast time.''
